question_text: Form a quadratic equation whose roots are −3 ± 5i.

recall_prompt: Say how you would form the equation — say what two numbers you compute from the roots and which formula you put them into.
insider_note: i² = −1 makes the product 9 + 25, not 9 − 25, and −(α + β) with a negative sum makes the middle term POSITIVE. Both signs go against habit, and both marks sit on them.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Sum and product
steps.margin_note: First mark. The imaginary parts cancel in the sum: −3 + 5i − 3 − 5i = −6. The product is (−3)² − (5i)² = 9 − 25i² = 9 + 25 = 34, because i² = −1 turns the minus into a plus.

recall.must_convey: That the two roots are added to get −6 and multiplied, using i² = −1, to get 9 + 25 = 34.
accept: add the roots to get minus six and multiply them to get nine minus twenty five i squared which is thirty four
sum is minus six, product is nine plus twenty five equals thirty four because i squared is minus one
the imaginary parts cancel in the sum and the product is thirty four

steps.why: Complex roots of a real quadratic come as a conjugate pair, so their sum and product are both real and the equation has real coefficients. i² = −1 is the only fact that changes the arithmetic from the surd case.
common_mistakes: Writing the product as 9 − 25 = −16 by forgetting i² = −1.
Getting the sum as 0 or as −6 + 10i.

steps.label: Write the equation
steps.margin_note: Second mark. The formula has −(α + β)x, and α + β = −6, so the middle term is +6x. Two minus signs make a plus; this is the line where the sign is lost.

recall.must_convey: That the equation is x² − (sum)x + (product) = 0, and with sum −6 this becomes x² + 6x + 34 = 0.
accept: x squared minus sum x plus product with sum minus six gives x squared plus six x plus thirty four
minus of minus six is plus six so the equation is x squared plus six x plus thirty four equals zero
the equation is x squared plus six x plus thirty four equals zero
sum minus six kabatti minus into minus plus avthundi, x squared plus six x plus thirty four
x squared plus six x plus thirty four

steps.why: x² − (α + β)x + αβ = (x − α)(x − β), so this formula gives exactly the quadratic with those two roots. The sign of the middle term follows from the sign of the sum.
